understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level while avoiding spike tiles and completing the game within the available attempts and turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed horizontally with MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing on a solid tile, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity determines the direction of falling, and landing on spikes ends the attempt. CLICK removes a clickable breakable tile at the specified coordinates and can open a new fall path; it does not necessarily move the player. UNDO reverts the previous action. The landing previews and corridor scan indicate which horizontal choices lead to useful passages, so movement should be directed toward safe passage columns and clicks should remove blocks that obstruct progress.
